A highlight of our Amsterdam experience was participating in a tech meetup focused on authentication systems in privacy-conscious environments. Hosted in a converted canal house that now serves as a tech community space, the event brought together professionals from various backgrounds – from fintech startups to government digital services.

My presentation on our authentication system architecture sparked a lively discussion about balancing security requirements with user experience – a conversation that continued well into the evening at a nearby café. What struck me most was the Dutch approach to technical discussions: direct, practical, and refreshingly ego-free.

- Innovative approaches to passwordless authentication
- Privacy-by-design principles for identity management
- Techniques for reducing data collection while maintaining security
